description: This file defines an AutoMapper profile class used to map domain entities (CatalogItem, CatalogType, CatalogBrand) to their respective DTOs for public API responses in the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: An AutoMapper Profile class configuring object-to-object mappings between domain entities and DTOs.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that defines mappings from CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand to their respective DTOs, including custom property mappings.
